points.location_basis: Existing fid3 at 28.2779807124 N, 85.3780340267 E, Gyirong/Rasuwagadhi sector; spatial proxy, not a surveyed velocity section.
points.speed_basis: Yin et al., DOI 10.16031/j.cghc.202610008: mean arrival speed about 22 m/s at Gyirong. Our local, depth-weighted mean phase speed over the first 60 s is an operational proxy, not an identical observable.
points.arrival_basis: Li et al., DOI 10.1007/s11629-026-1482-y: 14.2 km along Lende in about 350 s. Repository river-axis chainage from projected source centroid to fid3 is about 13.46 km. Model t=0 is source release in the valley; correspondence is approximate.
points.uncertainty_basis: Factor 5 tolerances requested for this screening experiment; NOT measured confidence intervals. Spatial radius, wet threshold and first-wave window are modelling choices. A pass is not independent validation.

excluded: 67 m/s concerns the avalanche impact, outside our simulated stage. Unlocated bend speed, run-up and whole-cascade travel time are not calibration targets. The separate 36.2 m/s gorge estimate is context, not a second independent observation.
